import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def f(g):
    R=len(g); C=len(g[0]); o=[r[:] for r in g]
    n=sum(1 for i in range(R) if len(set(g[i]))==1)
    srows=[i for i in range(R) if len(set(g[i]))==1]
    scols=[j for j in range(C) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(R)})==1]
    c=n
    for j in scols:
        for i in range(R): o[i][j]=c
    for i in srows:
        for j in range(C): o[i][j]=c
    return o
print(f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'], f(G['Demo pair 2 input'])==G['Demo pair 2 output'])
o=f(G['Test input']); print(json.dumps(o))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
stats=[]
for k in range(1,9):
    A=G[f'Demo pair {k} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    R,C=len(A),len(A[0])
    sr=[r for r in range(R) if len(set(A[r]))==1]
    sc=[c for c in range(C) if len({A[rr][c] for rr in range(R)})==1]
    nc=sum(1 for c in range(C) if len({A[rr][c] for rr in range(R)})==1)
    vals=set(x for r in A for x in r)
    lc={A[r][0] for r in sr}|{A[0][c] for c in sc}
    s=(R,C,len(sr),nc,sorted(vals),sorted(lc),sum(A[0]),min(vals),max(vals))
    stats.append(s)
# print features
for s in stats: print(s)
T=G['Test input']; R_,C_=len(T),len(T[0])
sr=[r for r in range(R_) if len(set(T[r]))==1]
sc=[c for c in range(C_) if len({T[rr][c] for rr in range(R_)})==1]
print('TEST:',(R_,C_,len(sr),len(sc),sorted(set(x for r in T for x in r)),sorted({T[r][0] for r in sr}|{T[0][c] for c in sc}),sum(T[0]),min(set(x for r in T for x in r)),max(set(x for r in T for x in r))))
